# Event 1: General 4-Choice Native Diplomacy & Frontier Integration Charter
oe_col2_native.1 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_col2_native.1.title
	desc = oe_col2_native.1.desc
	outcome = neutral
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_maritime_silk_road.dds"

	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		has_variable = oe_col2_last_colony_loc
		var:oe_col2_last_colony_loc = { has_owner = yes }
	}

	immediate = {
		var:oe_col2_last_colony_loc = {
			save_scope_as = oe_col2_colony_hub
		}
	}

	# Option A: Tribal Compact & Fur/Spice Trade
	option = {
		name = oe_col2_native.1.a
		custom_tooltip = oe_col2_native.1.a.tt
		scope:oe_col2_colony_hub = {
			add_location_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_col2_native_treaty_mod
				years = 25
				mode = replace
			}
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 30
			modifier = {
				factor = 1.5
				oe_col2_is_maritime_charter_power = yes
			}
		}
	}

	# Option B: Intermarriage & Frontier Synthesis
	option = {
		name = oe_col2_native.1.b
		custom_tooltip = oe_col2_native.1.b.tt
		scope:oe_col2_colony_hub = {
			add_location_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_col2_native_synthesis_mod
				years = 25
				mode = replace
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col2_frontier_synthesis_count } }
			set_variable = { name = oe_col2_frontier_synthesis_count value = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_variable = { name = oe_col2_frontier_synthesis_count add = 1 }
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 30
			modifier = {
				factor = 1.5
				oe_col2_is_cossack_frontier_power = yes
			}
		}
	}

	# Option C: Chartered Company Monopoly
	option = {
		name = oe_col2_native.1.c
		custom_tooltip = oe_col2_native.1.c.tt
		add_gold = 35
		scope:oe_col2_colony_hub = {
			add_location_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_col2_native_company_mod
				years = 25
				mode = replace
			}
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 20
			modifier = {
				factor = 1.6
				gold < 100
			}
		}
	}

	# Option D: Military Garrison & Rapid Assimilation
	option = {
		name = oe_col2_native.1.d
		custom_tooltip = oe_col2_native.1.d.tt
